title: Tunisian Crumble Cake
description: Moist and delicious cake made with Tunisian spices, topped with crumble mixture.

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or use a mix of cinnamon, cumin, and coriander

instructions: Grease a 20cm (8-inch) round cake pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and Tunisian spice blend.
Add softened butter and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top.
In a separate bowl, mix crumble topping with a fork until crumbly.
Spread crumble mixture evenly over the cake batter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
